supplementaryReferences.title: Edible part and local use
supplementaryReferences.quote: The fruits are edible, but sour, and can be eaten raw.
supplementaryReferences.note: Food is the berry; the same SANBI account reports poisonous tuberous roots. September–June describes berry occurrence, not a measured ripe-picking interval.

care: Provide a trellis or other support. Young plants need water until established; SANBI describes later drought tolerance and sun to semi-shade use.
purchase: Ask for Rhoicissus tridentata and record local ripe-fruit months. Do not use medicinal or animal root use as food evidence.

sourceChecks.observations: Read indexed primary SANBI page content. Direct PlantZAfrica requests in this audit returned HTTP 403; this is not a claim that every individual endpoint was live-tested.

gaps: No exact ripe-picking window or food kg; roots must stay excluded.
